page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-96-lssd is a member of the c4d server family, built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 372.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes NVMe SSD storage, integrated as eight local SSDs, and does not include any GPU accelerators.

This instance type provides a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources, aligning with a standard general-purpose profile. The high density of 96 dedicated vCPUs combined with local NVMe SSD storage supports high-throughput operations without the overhead of shared-core architectures. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a dense consolidation of compute resources and fast local storage, making it suitable for workloads requiring high parallel processing capabilities and low-latency disk access without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.

The c4d-standard-96-lssd is designed for demanding multi-threaded workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale web serving, database hosting, containerized microservices, continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local NVMe storage.
